research_rationale: All four replica pages read visually. This is Frank L. Polk's 18 April 1919 order under delegated EO 3016 authority, not a presidential act issued in 1918 merely because of the raw filename. Page 3 authorizes and directs release of rights in 50,000 shares to Ludwig Vogelstein on Custodian terms, including securing indebtedness, trust/security arrangements, and preventing German ownership/control for a period selected by the Custodian. Page 2 describes a prior transfer TO the Custodian, not performance of the newly directed release TO Vogelstein. Page 4 states reasons and an offer to pay, not a receipt or proof of later performance. No first ending or current predicate is established. Frozen OCR materially corrupts the authority recital, statutory dates, names and quantities; leave bytes unchanged and block. Replacement inventory divides the actual page-3 powers and removes page-number/reasons artifacts; it does not cure OCR or confirm a complete faithful text.
savings_reason: Accrued title, obligations, collateral and trust interests could survive a completed release. Their occurrence, terms and discharge are not established by the order. Distinguish prospective powers from consequences; infer neither actual transfer nor extinguishment.

research_rationale: Complete one-page replica read visually. Sections 1-3 create continuing Canal Zone clemency/prison-rule authorities and parole duties, not a single pardon. Section 4 expressly preserves existing rules until altered or amended by the Governor. It neither sunsets sections 1-3 nor proves that any Governor alteration occurred. Section 5 repeals earlier conflicting executive orders; section 6 delays operation thirty days after 5 March 1924 (4 April 1924), which is commencement, not cessation. No later actor or exact parent/subsequent statutory provision is supplied. Frozen OCR omits Governor in section 1 (Goer) and corrupts by order in section 2 (byore); these concern the legal actor and required instrument and prevent faithful-text confirmation. No bytes corrected and no whole-case submission.
